title: Parity tree index bijection
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $t$, there is a bijection between pairs consisting of an index in $\\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$ and an index in $\{0,\ldots,r^t-1\}$, and indices in $\{0,\ldots,r^{t+1}-1\}$.
